lemma.note: cq1 w10/14 (CatAgr 76.1 'l.' = libra 'pound'). de Vaan 2008 s.v. lībra: Proto-Italic *līþrā, cf. Sicilian Greek λίτρα; no PIE etymon accepted; the *leyH- 'pour'/'cling' link is a key collision. Unmapped.
cq1 w10/49 (CatAgr 84.1 papaver 'poppy'). de Vaan 2008 s.v. papāver: expressive/reduplicated, no PIE etymon; *péh₂wr̥ 'fire' is a key collision. Unmapped.
cq1 w10/50 (Catul 64.284 risit). de Vaan 2008 s.v. rīdeō: no accepted etymology; *wert- 'turn' unsupported. Unmapped.

cq1 w10/29 (Beo. 916 fyren 'crime'). Kaikki Old English fyren noun = firen 'crime, sin' (< *firinō; firen is unmapped); Bosworth-Toller s.v. firen. The rare adjective fȳren 'fiery' is not the Beowulf/Grein word. Unmapped like firen.
cq1 w10/98 (Il. 22.293 μείλινον ἔγχος 'ashen spear'). Beekes 2010 s.v. μελία 'ash-tree' (μείλινος 'of ash-wood'): no IE etymology, not μέλι 'honey' (*mélit, a key collision). Unmapped.
cq1 w10/98 (Od. 22.259 μελίη = the ash spear). Beekes 2010 s.v. μελία: no IE etymology; *mélit 'honey' is a key collision. Unmapped.
cq1 w10/98, same lexeme in the GLAUx population (Hesiod, Hippocrates, Aristophanes μελία 'ash'). Beekes 2010 s.v. μελία. Unmapped.
cq1 w10/98, same lexeme in the GLAUx population. Beekes 2010 s.v. μελία. Unmapped.

cq1 w10/15, w11/35 (+12 observations): the Mede(s), ethnonym of Iranian origin (Kaikki Ancient Greek Μῆδος; Beekes 2010 s.v.), never μῆδος 'counsel' (*mḗdos). The batch-9 'already fixed' verdict checked the grp table only; the grc/grc-late production units still mapped 343 tokens. Unmapped.

cq1 w11/15 (lav 177.10) and formula scan line 17 (birchbark 531 зерѧ). Old Russian зьрѣти 'look, see' = Proto-Slavic *zьrěti 'see' (Derksen 2008 s.v. *zьrěti 'look'; Lith. žėrė́ti 'glitter'; PIE *ǵʰer- 'shine, see'), not the homonym *zьrěti 'ripen' (*ǵerh₂-).
cq1 class of w11/15: прозьрѣти 'see again, recover sight' (Lav. 111.13, 241.36; nov-sin), prefixed *zьrěti 'see' (Derksen 2008).
cq1 class of w11/15 (CCMH Suprasliensis прозьрѣти 'regain sight'); round-3 table had *ǵerh₂- 'grow old'. Derksen 2008 s.v. *zьrěti 'look'.
cq1 w11/46: старуха 'old woman', lemmatised старик by the form table (57 tokens; rule in pie/cq1_other.py). Same derivative of старый < *starъ < *sth₂ró-s as старик.

proto.note: cq1 formula scan line 16 (Vuk 1547:256 дете). Derksen 2008 p.103 s.v. *dětę 'child' (< *dʰeh₁(i)- 'suck'); the automatic path ran through the *dětь page into *dʰéh₁tis 'putting'. Same decision as the earlier dijete erratum.
cq1 formula scan line 16: deca/djeca 'children' (*dětьca, collective of *dětь 'children', Derksen 2008 s.v. *dětę, *dětь) < *dʰeh₁(i)- 'suck', not *dʰéh₁tis.

cq1 formula scan line 17 (Suprasliensis 3104225 зракъ) and w11/15 class: *zorkъ 'look, sight' (Derksen 2008 s.v. *zьrěti 'look') belongs to *zьrěti 'see' < *ǵʰer- 'shine', not to the homonym 'ripen' (*ǵerh₂-) that the lexicon reflex list follows.
